task.name: Phase 2: Core Implementation
task.description: Build CLI entry point and all 5 Google Ads API commands
task.action:
1. Implement src/lib/client.ts: - Google Ads API client wrapper - Load credentials from ~/.google-ads-cli/config.json - Handle authentication (developer_token, client_id, client_secret, refresh_token) - Support multiple customer accounts
2. Implement src/index.ts: - CLI entry point using commander - Register all 5 commands - Version, help, global options - Shebang: #!/usr/bin/env node
3. Implement src/commands/list-campaigns.ts: - List campaigns with optional filter - Support --customer-id flag for multi-account
4. Implement src/commands/get-cpa-metrics.ts: - Fetch CPA metrics (CRITICAL - replaces Python script) - Support date ranges (TODAY, YESTERDAY, LAST_7_DAYS, etc) - Support campaign filter
5. Implement src/commands/update-budget.ts: - Update campaign budget - Requires --campaign-id and --amount
6. Implement src/commands/generate-report.ts: - Generate formatted performance report - Support date range and metrics selection
7. Implement src/commands/manage-campaign.ts: - Create/pause/enable campaigns - Subcommands: create, pause, enable
8. Update package.json: - Add "bin": {"google-ads-cli": "./dist/index.js"} - Add build script: "tsc" - Add dev script: "tsx src/index.ts"
task.verify: - All 7 TypeScript files exist - TypeScript compiles without errors (tsc --noEmit) - CLI has proper commander structure - Google Ads API client handles auth - All 5 commands registered - No console.log debug statements
task.done: - Core implementation complete - All commands functional - TypeScript clean compile - Ready for build and installation
